note: Resorcinolo ad alta pressione e doping per stabilizzare a pressione ambiente le fasi di alta pressione (resorcinolo, imidazolo, benzimidazolo, 2-metilbenzimidazolo). Le ricristallizzazioni ad alta pressione da soluzione (isoterme e isocore) sono PREPARAZIONI (epsilon sopra 0.20 GPa, zeta sopra 0.70 GPa), non eventi; sono eventi la decompressione di epsilon, le compressioni senza trasformazione (isteresi), il monoidrato che si scioglie lasciando epsilon, il congelamento del fuso con dopante e le macinazioni senza effetto. Un evento per ogni riga di Tabella 3 e Tabella 4 (congelamento del fuso della miscela ospite+dopante). Dalla frase dell'articolo «The absence of the higher-pressure polymorph ζ in any of the doped samples» non nasce un evento (riassume le tabelle). I campioni di riferimento del composto puro congelati dal fuso («as well as the reference sample of the pure compound») non hanno un esito nel testo. Le righe di 5% e 25% di Ta e gli altri dati sono nel supplementare (Tabella S6). Il solo CCDC del lavoro è l'intervallo 2084039–2084046 (otto strutture), non attribuibile alle forme (Tabella S1 nel supplementare); la Tabella 1 dà sei celle a pressioni diverse. Pressione interna del dopante pd (eq. 2): calcolata dagli autori dal volume molecolare, dalla concentrazione e dal modulo di bulk; è in condizioni.altro, NON come pressione applicata. Il testo dice «polymorph β is metastable in all ranges of investigated pressure» a 300 K (beta del resorcinolo): nessuna relazione di coppia, perche' non dice rispetto a quale forma per ogni intervallo. Incoerenze del testo: (1) il testo dice «In the experiment of mixing BzIm with 5% dM-BzIm, we obtained a 100% yield of doped BzIm polymorph β», la Tabella 4 ha la riga «M-BzIm 5% | 0.0469 | 0.07 | 100% β» per BzIm: si segue la tabella; (2) la Tabella 2 dà per l'imidazolo solo M-BzIm come dopante, ma la Tabella 4 ha per l'imidazolo i dopanti BzIm (5% e 25%) e M-BzIm (25%); (3) introduzione: «Polymorph α could be isothermally compressed to 4 GPa; however, in other experiments, it transformed to polymorph β at 0.5 GPa», poi «polymorphs α and β persisted to 5 GPa»; (4) sezione sperimentale: α, β ed ε «could be isothermally compressed to over 1 GPa», risultati: ε «could be compressed to 1 GPa, at which they were crushed»; (5) l'abstract dice che l'isteresi arriva «to nearly 5 GPa», il testo che α e β persistono «to 5 GPa»; (6) refusi: «2-methlybenimidazole», «5,6-dimethibenzimidazole».

citazioni: Characteristically, polymorphs α, β, and ε could be isothermally compressed to over 1 GPa, while high-pressure recrystallization between 0.20 and 0.70 GPa resulted in polymorph ε only.
Owing to the wide hysteresis of resorcinol polymorphs, their volume compressibility βv = −(1/V) dV/dp|T=296 K could be independently determined at 0.1 MPa at 296 K (Figure 1a)
The hysteresis, originating from the H-bonding networks, hinders the formation of polymorphs ε and ζ when polymorphs α and β are compressed without melting or dissolving the crystals.

citazioni: The single crystals of polymorph ε could be compressed to 1 GPa, at which they were crushed. By performing in situ PXRD measurements, we confirmed that the tiny fragments are still in the ε phase.

The damage was due to mechanical reasons caused by anisotropic strain in the elongated crystal samples bridging the opposite edges of the steel gaskets (Figures S1 and S2), which plastically deformed when the pressure in the DAC was increased.
eventi.conflitto: Sezione sperimentale: «polymorphs α, β, and ε could be isothermally compressed to over 1 GPa»; risultati: ε «could be compressed to 1 GPa, at which they were crushed». Si tiene il dato puntuale dei risultati.
eventi.note: I cristalli di ε si frantumano a 1 GPa per cause meccaniche (deformazione anisotropa fra i bordi della guarnizione), ma i frammenti restano ε (PXRD in situ). Nessuna transizione a ζ, che sarebbe stabile sopra 0.70 GPa.

citazioni: In another series of experiments, polymorph ε nucleated and grew in the form of a single crystal from the aqueous solution in the presence of resorcinol monohydrate (Figure S2): first, the monohydrate crystal was grown in the DAC at 0.80 GPa, and after releasing the pressure to 0.35 GPa, it started to dissolve while another crystal nucleated. After further reduction of the pressure to 0.20 GPa, the monohydrate dissolved completely, and a crystal of ε-resorcinol was isothermally grown when the pressure was slowly increased up to 0.25 GPa (Figure S2); the crystal grew when the pressure was increased to 0.50 GPa, and then no change in the size or shape was noticed.
eventi.pretrattamento: cristallo di monoidrato cresciuto nella DAC a 0.80 GPa
eventi.note: Sequenza nella DAC: monoidrato cresciuto a 0.80 GPa; portando la pressione a 0.35 GPa «it started to dissolve while another crystal nucleated»; a 0.20 GPa il monoidrato si e' sciolto del tutto; poi ε e' cresciuta isotermicamente aumentando lentamente la pressione fino a 0.25 GPa e ancora fino a 0.50 GPa. Si riporta 0.35 GPa (inizio della dissoluzione e nucleazione). Il testo non dice se l'«altro cristallo» nucleato a 0.35 GPa sia gia' ε: lo e' quello che cresce dopo la dissoluzione completa a 0.20 GPa.

citazioni: Samples of 4.1 mg of ambient-pressure polymorphs (α-phase) of selected compounds listed in Table 2 were mixed by grinding with a dopant at 5, 15, and 25 wt % ratios and recrystallized by freezing the melt, following the procedure reported for α-resorcinol mixed with d-tartaric acid (d-Ta) by Zhu et al.24

Each of these mixtures, as well as the reference sample of the pure compound, was heated on the thermal stage of a microscope until all crystal grains were molten, after which the samples were left to cool down to room temperature and recrystallize (Figure S9).
The cooling of the molten mixture from ca. 370–300 K took about 10 min, but the molten sample froze in few seconds.

Subsequently, the samples were characterized by PXRD using a Bruker D8 diffractometer operating in the θ–2θ geometry with a Johansson monochromator, λ(Cu Kα1) = 1.54060 Å, and a LynxEye silicon-strip detector. The PXRD patterns were compared with the reference patterns calculated for the pure-compound phases as well as the applied dopant.42,43 In this way, the polymorphs constituting the samples were identified, and their ratio was established by comparing the intensities of reflections.
eventi.note: Riga di Tabella 3 (resorcinolo + dopante, congelato dal fuso). α-resorcinolo mescolato per macinazione col dopante, fuso sul vetrino riscaldante e raffreddato; PXRD quantitativa dei polimorfi.

citazioni: This doped β-BzIm sample was stable for at least several months.

Rational doping by molecules larger than the host compound molecules can generate an internal strain in the melt, which mimics external compression and leads to high-pressure polymorphs. The doping pressure concept requires that single dopant molecules larger than the host molecules be randomly distributed in the host melt and crystal structure. Then, the internal pressure can be assessed from the molecular volume difference, dopant concentration, and host bulk modulus. The doping pressure is strongly inhomogeneous, but it shifts the thermodynamic equilibrium for nucleation toward high-pressure polymorphs and stabilizes them under ambient conditions.
eventi.note: Campione di β-BzIm drogato (100% β, E20), «stable for at least several months»; la temperatura non e' scritta ('ambient conditions' nelle conclusioni), quindi tipo ambiente senza numero. La forma attesa a cui tornerebbe (α) non e' nominata per questa prova: a = ignota. Tecnica non detta per il controllo di stabilita'.

citazioni: Preparation of doped samples, analogous to those obtained in the melting and freezing process, by milling mixtures of 4.1 mg of the ambient-pressure polymorph with the dopants listed in Table 2 at 5, 10, 15, 20, and 25 wt % was attempted.
The samples were milled in hardened steel containers with several steel balls at a frequency of 30 Hz for 4 h. An MM 400 mill was used for all the powder samples.
The subsequent PXRD patterns showed no changes in the ambient-pressure components in the mixtures, and no high-pressure polymorphs were detected.
eventi.note: Macinazione (non fusione) di resorcinol con i dopanti elencati per l'ospite nella Tabella 2 (5-25 wt %): nessun cambiamento, nessun polimorfo di alta pressione. La frase vale per tutti gli ospiti della Tabella 2 («the ambient-pressure polymorph»): un evento per ospite. Gli autori spiegano che la macinazione non distribuisce molecole di dopante isolate nel grano («milling is very unlikely to result in a uniform distribution of single dopant molecules»).

citazioni: After further reduction of the pressure to 0.20 GPa, the monohydrate dissolved completely, and a crystal of ε-resorcinol was isothermally grown when the pressure was slowly increased up to 0.25 GPa (Figure S2); the crystal grew when the pressure was increased to 0.50 GPa
